critical_code_review_comments: routes/whatsapp_link.py:ComposeIn — offer_type default is 'general' and pattern enforces enum, good; discount_pct is Optional[int] but the LLM prompt substitutes `body.discount_pct or 15` on 'discount' path (line 161). If offer_type='discount' with no discount_pct sent, the API silently uses 15% — consider validating that discount_pct is required when offer_type=='discount' (a model_validator).

routes/winback.py:winback_blast queue path — when own_number is true it inserts BOTH a wa_campaign doc AND per-guest lead_outreach 'whatsapp' rows immediately (before actual delivery). If the campaign is paused/cancelled before dispatch, those outreach rows will still block the 30-day cooldown for guests who never actually received a message. Consider inserting outreach rows only after the throttler dispatches each message.

components/crm/WaCampaignModal.jsx:33 — sends `discount_pct: offerType==='discount' ? discount : null` but the backend model has discount_pct ge=5. If a user picks 5% via UI it's fine (min is 10 in the UI); but if they somehow pick a different offer_type + edit discount_pct, backend still ignores it — align UI/backend so discount select is only sent for the discount offer_type (already correct here). No action needed.

components/crm/WaCampaignModal.jsx:84 — <select> option children include a nested <span> tag (from Tailwind [&_option] class utilities). This produces a React hydration warning ('<span> cannot be a child of <option>'). Non-blocking but flagged for cleanup.

schedulers.py:_sms_reminder_scheduler — the 1-hour heads-up loop uses the SAME 30-minute cadence as the 24h reminder; a booking made 65 minutes ahead may miss the window (45–75 min). Consider shorter cadence (e.g., every 10-15 min) for the 1h block, or widen the window to 30–90 min.
